Nina: Post-RFC sync: we need a clear contract for quantization tweaks. Customers want control but ops needs stable telemetry. I propose compiled_profile tokens (signed, short-lived) + three canonical contracts (hq, balanced, eco). Open to other options.

Omar: Compiled tokens seem good. Runtime fast-path should only do a local cache lookup and signature-check if needed. Avoid network on p99.

Chen: We should restrict what overrides can do. My suggestion: allow cache_policy and attn_chunk only. Anything that touches per-layer calibration or weight-scale must be part of a new canonical contract and go through model QA.

Vik: For validation, run these steps when compiling overrides: (1) schema validation, (2) safety heuristics (no negative scales, reasonable chunk sizes), (3) lightweight shadow eval (5 prompts) -> compare degscore. If degscore delta > 0.03 reject. This prevents noisy regressions.

Nina: How to handle telemetry cardinality? If every tenant generates unique compiled_profile_ids we lose signal. We should emit aggregated dims: (contract_id, coarse_override_bucket, safety_tier) and record compiled_profile_id only for debugging traces.

Omar: Also quota per-tenant: max 5 active compiled tokens. Enforce expiry (default 24h) and require recompile for longer-lived changes.

ci-bot: NOTICE: canary job created: canary/compiled-profile-fastpath at 1% for 8h. See https://go/ops/canaries/compiled-profile-fastpath

Chen: Runtime fallback rules: if token missing or invalid -> fall back to contract_id. If compiled token present but application fails safety checks at runtime (e.g., outliers in latency/degscore), immediately map to contract default and emit alert. No retries. Deterministic and auditable.

Vik: Cache key pattern: precision:compiled:{tenant_id}:{model_hash}:{compiled_id}. TTL 24h; prewarm on compiled_token issuance via publish hook. Keep per-tenant namespace to allow easy revocation.

Nina: Private deployment policy: default disabled. Dedicated: opt-in with SRE review. Hosted: allowed under whitelist + tenant quota. We'll document gating flow.

Omar: Example compiled token format (short):
```
base64(sig | cpid | tenant_id | ttl)
```
Runtime trust path: if cache miss, check local signature + expiry; if signature valid but not cached, fetch compiled blob from validator service as rare path.

Nina: Action list: (A) Chen to write whitelist of allowed override keys; (B) Vik to prototypify token format + cache keys; (C) Omar to draft telemetry aggregation and dashboard; (D) Nina to update RFC and coordinate SRE/legal for Private policy.

Vik: I'll also add compile_failure metrics with reason tags (schema, shadow_eval, quota). Helps ops triage.

ci-bot: INFO: rollout note added to runbook: ops/precision-compiled-fastpath.

Nina: Thanks all. Goal: short RFC annex and implementation tickets by EOW.
